result.final_text:
## What this letter says

You had a breast X-ray (mammogram) as part of breast screening. You need to come back for more tests. This is called a recall. Being called back does not mean that you have cancer. About 4 in 5 women who are called back do not have breast cancer. An appointment has been booked for you.

## What you need to do

1. Go to your appointment. It is at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital. It is on Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00.
2. If you cannot come, call 01632 960 733 as soon as possible.
3. You can bring a friend or family member with you if you want to.

At the appointment you may have more breast X-rays (mammograms). You may have an ultrasound scan. In some cases, you may have a biopsy. This means a small sample of tissue is taken. You will usually get most of your results on the same day. The visit may take up to 4 hours.

## Dates and medicines

- 16 September 2026: you had your breast X-ray (mammogram).
- Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00: your recall appointment at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital.

The letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor

- What is an ultrasound scan?
- Which tests will I have at my appointment?
- How will I get any results that are not ready on the same day?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
